scripts.dev: pnpm run build:vite && pnpm run dev:zola
scripts.dev:all: pnpm run build:vite && concurrently -k -n zola,vite -c blue,magenta "pnpm dev:zola" "pnpm dev:vite"
scripts.build: pnpm run build:vite && pnpm run build:zola
scripts.build:all: pnpm run build:vite && pnpm run build:admin && pnpm run build:subset-titlefont && pnpm run build:subset-bodyfont && pnpm run check:short-links && pnpm run build:zola && pnpm run build:beasties && pnpm run build:rewrite-artifacts && pnpm run build:markdown
scripts.lint: pnpm run build:vite && pnpm run lint:zola
scripts.test:rust: cargo nextest run --locked --all-features --config-file nextest.toml && cargo test --locked --all-features --doc
scripts.verify:rust: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && pnpm test:rust
scripts.lint:ts: eslint --cache themes/hibikilogy/src themes/hibikilogy/components cms scripts vite.config.ts vite.admin.config.ts vitest.config.ts
scripts.verify:ts: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:ts && pnpm lint:ts && pnpm build:vite && pnpm build:admin
scripts.build:subset-titlefont: cargo run --locked --features font-tools --bin title-font-subset -- --content-dir content --font themes/hibikilogy/static/fonts/SourceHanSerifCN-VF.ttf --font-output-dir themes/hibikilogy/static/fonts --css-output-dir themes/hibikilogy/static/styles --css-file source-han-serif-cn-vf.css --font-family "Source Han Serif CN VF" --output-file source-han-serif-cn-vf.woff2
scripts.build:subset-bodyfont: cargo run --locked --features font-tools --bin body-font-subset -- --content-dir content --config config.toml --font themes/hibikilogy/static/fonts/SourceHanSansSC-VF.ttf --base-css themes/hibikilogy/static/styles/source-han-sans-sc-vf.css --font-output-dir themes/hibikilogy/static/fonts --css-output-dir themes/hibikilogy/static/styles --css-file source-han-sans-sc-vf.patch.css --font-family "Source Han Sans SC VF" --output-file source-han-sans-sc-vf.patch.woff2
scripts.build:rewrite-artifacts: cargo run --locked --features artifact-rewrite --bin site-artifact-rewrite -- --rules scripts/artifact-rewrite.toml --cache-dir static/_cache public
